changes.summary: Continue an accepted Programmable or Uniswap v4 design into complete implementation work instead of treating a missing bundled profile as a refusal condition, with an exact EN/DE structural trigger corpus that remains distinct from provider-level semantic proof.

For custom tradable projects, preserve a complete caller-supplied dependency lock, remappings, Foundry settings, safe root configuration and contract tree with at most one web, service, or game source tree as inert byte-and-mode-bound inputs; omitted new configuration flags retain the v0.9.1 convenience default, and all input trees enforce incremental entry, directory, depth, file, and byte limits.
Produce a deterministic no-write handoff that binds the complete project, central launch-policy preimages, protected Submit base, and intended draft pull-request identity.

Add a deterministic external sandbox-host plan and exact raw-Git tree archive that ignores export attributes, rejects unsupported modes, bounds combined entries and retained bytes, and finalizes without replacement, while keeping portable execution and completion fail-closed until independently trusted host evidence exists.

Add a versioned anti-leakage benchmark harness for Builder journeys with bounded workspaces, sidecars, metrics, effects, and aggregate evidence, including an append-only correction that keeps the Mizu design-only turn NOT_ACTIVATED and requires its explicit implementation continuation to become ACTIVATED.
Separate repository-only development tests from the portable runtime through one manifest-bound package closure and retain installed runtime smoke verification.

Document that a pre-1.0 patch may add optional backward-compatible capabilities without new required existing inputs or incompatible contracts, and that contributors author and push the candidate while a separate current CODEOWNER reviews, approves, squash-merges, tags, and publishes the exact accepted revision.
